Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to disambiguate between two different individuals named Hardyal Singh. The search results clearly showed an entry for "Hardyal Singh Dhillon" (died 2011) and a separate entry for "Hardyal Singh" the hockey player (died 2018). The agent incorrectly aggregated these results or selected the wrong individual (the hockey player who died in 2018) without verifying if this was the intended subject of the comparison. The correct subject to compare against Antonio Caggiano (who died in 1979) is Hardyal Singh Dhillon (died 2011), who lived to be 89 years old (1928-2011), making the lifespans nearly identical but requiring a precise calculation to determine the winner. By selecting the hockey player (1928-2018, ~90 years), the agent created a false conclusion that Hardyal Singh lived longer.
